inbodydescription.para: VCK190/VMK180 boards have VCC_AUX workaround where MIO-37 (PMC GPIO) is used to enable the VCC_RAM which used to power the PL. As a result, if PMC GPIO is disabled, VCC_RAM goes off. To prevent this from happening, request PMC GPIO device on behalf PMC subsystem. This will take care of the use cases where PMC is up. GPIO will get reset only when PMC goes down.
The VCC_AUX workaround will be removed from MIO-37 in future.
